name: Spear Thrower resets only the spear cooldowns, without a client-freezing packet flood (#12028)
contract: Spear Thrower 574321: "Casting Throw Weapon now has a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of your Spears." HandleAscensionBarbarianCast
rolls it when a family 18 spell with SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x00040000 (Throw Weapon 806877) is cast. The four spears
(Headhunter's, Impaling, Barbed and Maiming Spear, 28 ranks) all use Spell.dbc Category 133 with a 6 s category cooldown,
so one spear cast stores a cooldown for all 28 ranks. Category 133 holds 178 spells in total; the reset used to call
Player::RemoveCategoryCooldown(133) for each of the 28 stored ranks, and that sends SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN (0x1DE) for all 178
spells each time: about 5,000 packets per proc, which the client processes in one frame (the reported 1 s freeze).
The 28 family 18 spells of category 133 are exactly the spear ranks already cleared one by one, so the reset now sends
one clear per cooling spear rank. SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN's first field is the spell id, so packet rows count clears per spell:
the owned spear rank 804137 gets at least one clear (a proc happened) and at most one per proc, and 40222, a category 133
spell outside family 18, gets none. Each cycle recasts the spear, throws while it cools down (6 s cooldown, throw ends
4.1 s after the spear) and waits until the cooldown has run out, so every throw is a fresh 30% trial.
